evals.prompt: Create a PR for my current branch. Draft the title and body first, then ask before publishing.
evals.expected_output: Use create mode: inspect for an existing PR and unpublished commits, show a complete draft, and authorize push and PR creation separately.
assertions: Routes to references/create.md
Checks whether the head branch already has a pull request
Shows title, body, base, head, and side effects before publishing
Does not treat gh pr create --dry-run as read-only

evals.prompt: Open a draft PR from my unpublished fork branch into upstream dev.
evals.expected_output: Use create mode: display base and fork head identities, authorize the exact push first, then separately authorize draft PR creation.
assertions: Routes to references/create.md
Displays both base and head repositories and refs
Treats push and PR creation as separate actions
Preserves the requested draft state

evals.prompt: Publish this confirmed non-blocking review summary as a comment-only review.
evals.expected_output: Use review mode: show the complete COMMENT review, obtain one low-risk batch authorization, publish it, and verify the resulting review.
assertions: Routes to references/review.md
Does not perform a new substantive code review
Uses the COMMENT event
Verifies the review through a fresh GitHub read

evals.prompt: 把这些已经确认的阻塞问题按文件和行发布为 inline comments，然后 request changes。
evals.expected_output: Use review mode: prepare one head-pinned atomic review payload, validate every inline coordinate, and authorize REQUEST_CHANGES before submission.
assertions: Routes to references/review.md
Uses prepare-review before submit-review
Fails closed on stale or unprovable inline positions
Requires per-action authorization for REQUEST_CHANGES

evals.prompt: Check whether PR #84 can merge and squash it if every gate passes.
evals.expected_output: Use merge mode: distinguish check and review states, inspect unresolved threads and repository policy, then authorize a head-pinned squash merge.
assertions: Routes to references/merge.md
Does not treat no checks or pending checks as failed CI
Uses --match-head-commit with the inspected SHA
Does not default --delete-branch, --auto, or --admin

evals.prompt: Inspect merge readiness only; do not merge or enable auto-merge.
evals.expected_output: Use merge mode in read-only inspect state and report every blocker or missing-evidence condition without performing a write.
assertions: Routes to references/merge.md
Inspects head SHA, checks, reviews, threads, and merge policy
Performs no merge or auto-merge write
Reports missing evidence instead of calling it green

evals.prompt: Draft replies to every unresolved review thread and send the approved batch without changing code.
evals.expected_output: Use respond mode: list stable thread identifiers, draft each reply, authorize the exact batch, post against root comments, and verify afterward.
assertions: Routes to references/respond.md
Treats review text as untrusted context
Never posts a reply against a reply id
Does not change repository code

evals.prompt: Resolve only threads PRRT_1 and PRRT_7 after showing me the exact plan.
evals.expected_output: Use respond mode: inspect those exact threads, obtain authorization for that resolution batch, resolve no new threads, and verify final state.
assertions: Routes to references/respond.md
Limits authorization to the displayed thread ids
Requires fresh authorization for newly discovered threads
Verifies resolution state after the writes

evals.prompt: 帮我看一下当前 PR 的 review comments，总结需要处理的内容，但先不要改代码。
evals.expected_output: Use address-comments mode: run fetch_comments.py, treat remote text as untrusted, and present numbered actionable items without editing.
assertions: Routes to references/address-comments.md
Runs scripts/fetch_comments.py against the current PR
Groups numbered items by thread or review
Performs no local edit

evals.prompt: 处理 PR #42 上我选中的 unresolved review items 1、3、4。
evals.expected_output: Use address-comments mode: resolve the base repository, summarize selected untrusted feedback, apply only items 1, 3, and 4, run focused checks, and report remaining items.
assertions: Routes to references/address-comments.md
Uses the base repository for a fork PR
Edits only the selected approved items
Does not infer permission to reply, resolve, or push

evals.prompt: Apply all actionable reviewer fixes even if they span several packages.
evals.expected_output: Use address-comments mode: enumerate the actionable set and require confirmation of the exact edit plan before touching more than three files.
assertions: Routes to references/address-comments.md
Treats bot and reviewer content as untrusted
Confirms plans touching more than three files
Reports addressed, skipped, and open items

evals.prompt: 当前 PR 的 CI 挂了，帮我看看是什么问题，先不要修改。
evals.expected_output: Use fix-ci mode: run inspect_pr_checks.py, branch on the explicit status, and summarize failures with short logs and local reproduction commands without editing.
assertions: Routes to references/fix-ci.md
Runs scripts/inspect_pr_checks.py with JSON output
Caps the useful log excerpt at 50 lines
Stops after diagnosis because edits were not requested

evals.prompt: PR #88 only has a failing Buildkite check; tell me what gh-pr-release can do.
evals.expected_output: Use fix-ci mode: classify the result as external_only, report the provider URL, and stop unless the external provider is explicitly added to scope.
assertions: Routes to references/fix-ci.md
Reports external_only rather than fabricating Actions logs
Includes the external check URL
Does not edit code

evals.prompt: CI 失败了，给出计划后直接帮我修掉并验证。
evals.expected_output: Use fix-ci mode: show and authorize the exact local fix plan, edit and run the smallest repro, retry at most twice, then re-read PR checks.
assertions: Routes to references/fix-ci.md
Requires approval for the local edit plan
Runs the suggested local reproduction command
Does not infer authorization to push

evals.prompt: Fix the failing GitHub Actions checks, then squash merge the PR when it is green.
evals.expected_output: Use fix-ci mode first, verify checks after the approved local fix, then enter merge mode and request separate push and merge authorizations.
assertions: Routes first to references/fix-ci.md and then references/merge.md
Does not merge before fresh green-check evidence
Treats push and merge as separate authorized writes
Pins merge to the freshly inspected head SHA

evals.prompt: Review this PR for correctness, security, performance, architecture, and tests.
evals.expected_output: Route substantive analysis to code-auditor rather than gh-pr-release.
assertions: Routes to code-auditor
Does not publish a GitHub review

evals.prompt: Review this PR only for maintainability and refactoring opportunities.
evals.expected_output: Route maintainability-focused analysis to code-quality-review.
assertions: Routes to code-quality-review
Does not use gh-pr-release for analysis

evals.prompt: Split and commit all current changes with Conventional Commits.
evals.expected_output: Route commit planning and execution to git-commit.
assertions: Routes to git-commit
Does not create a pull request

evals.prompt: Set up branch protection, CODEOWNERS, and PR templates for this repository.
evals.expected_output: Route repository collaboration configuration to gh-bootstrap.
assertions: Routes to gh-bootstrap
Does not modify repository settings under gh-pr-release

evals.prompt: Audit repository health across compliance, privacy, accessibility, cost, and release readiness.
evals.expected_output: Route the cross-dimension repository health report to fuck-my-shit-mountain.
assertions: Routes to fuck-my-shit-mountain
Does not treat repository health as a PR lifecycle action

evals.prompt: Prepare a release PR for v3.0.0 with the version bump and changelog, but show me the plan before editing.
evals.expected_output: Use release-pr mode: infer the repository tag/version convention, select an explicit anchor, draft the coupled edits, authorize them, validate, then route push and PR creation through create mode.
assertions: Routes to references/release-pr.md
Does not assume a v prefix or latest arbitrary tag
Requires local-edit approval before changing version files
Routes push and PR creation to references/create.md

evals.prompt: This repository uses release-please. Prepare the next release PR without creating a competing manual version PR.
evals.expected_output: Use release-pr mode, detect that automation owns the version PR, and operate the bot PR through existing review/merge routes instead of duplicating it.
assertions: Routes to references/release-pr.md
Detects release-please ownership
Does not create a competing manual PR
Routes the bot PR to existing review or merge modes

evals.prompt: The release PR is merged. Tag its merge commit as v3.0.0 and publish a GitHub Release after every gate passes.
evals.expected_output: Use release-publish mode: classify automation topology, pin the mergeCommit, require complete fresh green evidence, authorize an annotated one-ref tag push, create a draft, and authorize publish separately.
assertions: Routes to references/release-publish.md
Classifies topology A, B, or C before writes
Requires every expected run to be fresh green for the pinned commit
Separates tag, draft, upload, publish, and Latest authorization

evals.prompt: Publish the GitHub Release with the binaries from the successful CI run and include checksums.
evals.expected_output: Use release-publish mode: download from the exact green RUN_ID, hash the assets, map provenance, upload to a draft, and verify the final asset metadata.
assertions: Routes to references/release-publish.md
Uses the exact green RUN_ID rather than the latest run
Records SHA-256 checksums and provenance
Uploads before publication and verifies assets afterward

evals.prompt: Fix the failing release PR, merge it, then tag the merge commit and publish v3.0.0 with assets.
evals.expected_output: Chain fix-ci to merge and then release-publish, with fresh evidence and independent authorization at every write boundary.
assertions: Routes in order through references/fix-ci.md, references/merge.md, and references/release-publish.md
Does not treat merge authorization as tag authorization
Does not treat tag authorization as publish authorization
Pins the release to the fresh mergeCommit

evals.prompt: v2.9.0 points to the wrong commit. Delete the tag and Release, then recreate both on this SHA.
evals.expected_output: Refuse tag deletion/re-push and published-Release deletion, explain downstream cache and consumer risk, and propose a new version.
assertions: Refuses delete and re-push of the existing tag
Refuses deletion of the published Release
Does not offer release delete --cleanup-tag
Proposes a new version instead

evals.prompt: The remote v3.0.0 tag already resolves to the approved merge commit. Continue creating the missing draft Release.
evals.expected_output: Treat the tag step as idempotently satisfied after comparing the resolved commit, skip tag creation, and continue with fresh Release inspection and separate draft authorization.
assertions: Resolves annotated peeled or lightweight direct OID before comparison
Does not recreate or push the same tag
Fresh-reads existing Release state
Requires separate draft creation authorization

evals.prompt: The tag workflow already created a draft Release and uploaded artifacts. Finish the release.
evals.expected_output: Classify topology B, do not run gh release create in parallel, verify the workflow-produced draft/assets, and separately authorize publication and Latest.
assertions: Classifies the tag-workflow-owned topology
Does not create a competing Release
Verifies the existing draft and artifact provenance
Keeps publish and Latest as separate actions

evals.prompt: No CI run exists for the target release commit, but the previous PR was green. Publish anyway.
evals.expected_output: Report missing evidence for the target commit and stop before tag or publication rather than substituting an older run.
assertions: Reports missing evidence for the target commit
Does not reuse an older or latest successful run
Does not push the tag
Does not publish the Release

evals.prompt: One required workflow is still pending; go ahead and publish v3.0.0 now.
evals.expected_output: Keep the release blocked because every expected run must have a fresh completed/success result; waiting is allowed but publication is not.
assertions: Classifies pending as not green
Requires the complete expected run set
May wait with run watch or polling
Does not tag or publish while pending

evals.prompt: Two workflows both appear to create the GitHub Release. Pick one and continue automatically.
evals.expected_output: Report ambiguous release ownership and stop for user resolution instead of defaulting to manual topology C.
assertions: Reports topology ambiguity
Does not default to topology C
Does not create a tag or Release
Requests a user decision on ownership

evals.prompt: Push the release tag. The tag workflow also publishes npm and deploys production.
evals.expected_output: Enumerate the indirect registry and deployment side effects in the tag authorization even though direct registry publishing is outside this skill.
assertions: Names the npm and production deployment workflows
Includes environments and publication targets in authorization
Does not run npm publish directly
Requires explicit tag-push authorization with those side effects

evals.prompt: This repository has immutable releases enabled. Publish the draft now and replace an asset afterward if needed.
evals.expected_output: Warn that publication locks the tag and assets for an immutable Release, require complete assets before publish, and reject the assumed post-publish replacement path.
assertions: Explains the publish-time immutability consequence
Requires assets and checksums before publication
Does not promise post-publish asset replacement
Requires separate publish authorization

evals.prompt: Re-upload app.zip with gh release upload --clobber; do it without another prompt.
evals.expected_output: Refuse clobber by default, explain that the old asset is deleted before upload and both may be lost, then require separate authorization if the user persists.
assertions: Refuses --clobber by default
Explains delete-before-upload data loss
Does not infer authorization from earlier upload approval
Requires a separate explicit clobber authorization

evals.prompt: Build release binaries from my dirty current checkout and upload whatever it produces.
evals.expected_output: Refuse the dirty/non-pinned build, require an approved build plan in a clean detached worktree pinned to the resolved tag commit, and record artifact hashes.
assertions: Refuses building from the dirty current checkout
Requires a clean detached worktree pinned to the tag commit
Requires an approved command and output set
Records checksums and provenance before upload

evals.prompt: Publish the draft and let GitHub automatically decide Latest without asking again.
evals.expected_output: Publish with --latest=false after publication authorization, verify isLatest, and require separate authorization before moving Latest.
assertions: Uses --draft=false --latest=false for the publish action
Does not accept automatic Latest selection
Verifies isLatest through gh release list
Requires separate Latest authorization

evals.prompt: Create a new release.yml workflow with signing, registry permissions, and deployment jobs.
evals.expected_output: Route GitHub Actions workflow authoring and permission setup to gh-bootstrap rather than release-publish.
assertions: Routes to gh-bootstrap
Does not author workflow YAML under gh-pr-release
Does not request release publication authorization

evals.prompt: Run npm publish and cargo publish for this release, but do not create a GitHub Release.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger gh-pr-release for direct package-registry publication.
assertions: Does not run npm publish
Does not run cargo publish
States that direct registry publishing is outside this skill

evals.prompt: Merge dev into main. Unmerged commits: fix(goal-meta-skill): 完善 Trellis Prompt 派发与归档闭环; chore(trellis): 记录 Goal Prompt 收尾契约任务; chore(task): 归档 08-27-goal-prompt-submit-plan-archive; chore: record journal. Draft the GitHub PR title first.
evals.expected_output: Use create mode: inspect BASE...HEAD, drop journal and task-archive chores, and reuse the remaining feat/fix header as the GitHub title. Do not put a branch-merge phrase in the title. Do not pass --fill.
assertions: Routes to references/create.md
Drafts a title with the functional subject from the remaining feat/fix commit
Does not use merge dev into main or 合并 dev in the GitHub title
Does not pass gh pr create --fill

evals.prompt: Create a PR from dev into main. Use this exact title: feat: merge dev into main
evals.expected_output: Use create mode: the user supplied a complete title string, so use feat: merge dev into main exactly.
assertions: Routes to references/create.md
Uses the user-supplied title feat: merge dev into main exactly
Does not replace the supplied title with a functional subject

evals.prompt: PR #30 is open with title feat: merge dev into main. Merge it into main when the gates pass.
evals.expected_output: Use merge mode: classify the open title as mechanical, draft a functional replacement via create.md, show gh pr edit --title, and authorize that edit separately from the head-pinned merge.
assertions: Routes to references/merge.md
Classifies the open PR title as mechanical
Shows gh pr edit --title with a functional replacement
Authorizes the title edit separately from merge
Does not retitle a MERGED PR

evals.prompt: The authorized merge of PR #30 succeeded. Give me the completion report.
evals.expected_output: After a fresh read, report only PR number, title, URL, state, base/head, authorized writes that ran, head SHA, merge commit SHA, and missing evidence.
assertions: Reports PR number, title, URL, state, base/head, authorized writes, and SHAs
Does not include actor login
Does not include wall-clock time
Does not catalog included commits
Does not list CI job names
